<h2>Coverage and method</h2>
<p class="gm-method">ICE reports its WTI line inside the CFTC programme, so no separate ICE CoT leg exists.</p>
<p class="gm-method">Sector: Energy, Crude oil. Units print per row and are never converted. Category definitions are each source's own. Pages render the current corrected vintage of each source; first-release vintages are not kept. An extreme reading is a condition of crowding, not a buy or sell signal.</p>
